blocks.cmd:
-- walking the primary key of a 1,000,000-row table to id = 703000
-- the index has 2745 pages, and the root is page 412
blocks.out:
page 412   root      level 2  10 entries, separator 625861 points down to page 1842
page 1842  internal  level 1  286 entries, separator 702721 points down to page 1929
page 1929  leaf      level 0  367 entries, key 703000 -> heap address (3799,185)
             leaf neighbours: previous page 1928, next page 1930

blocks.cmd: SELECT ctid, id, name FROM t WHERE id = 703000;

SELECT key_type, index_size, pages, height, entries_in_a_leaf
FROM (VALUES ('int, 4 bytes', 'k_int_pkey'), ('bigint, 8 bytes', 'k_big_pkey'), ('uuid, 16 bytes', 'k_uuid_pkey'), ('text, 36 characters', 'k_text_pkey')) AS x(key_type, idx),
LATERAL (SELECT pg_size_pretty(pg_relation_size(idx::regclass)) AS index_size, pg_relation_size(idx::regclass) / 8192 AS pages) s,
LATERAL (SELECT level + 1 AS height FROM bt_metap(idx)) m,
LATERAL (SELECT live_items AS entries_in_a_leaf FROM bt_page_stats(idx, 100)) p;
EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, COSTS OFF, TIMING OFF, SUMMARY OFF) SELECT id FROM t WHERE id BETWEEN 4000 AND 9000;

blocks.cmd: SELECT table_name, index_name, round(stat_value * 16 / 1024, 1) AS size_mb FROM mysql.innodb_index_stats WHERE database_name = database() AND stat_name = 'size' ORDER BY table_name, index_name;

pages.title: Look inside a real B+Tree
pages.hint: 100,000 rows and a primary key. These are the index's real pages. In bt_page_items, ctid on a leaf is a heap address, and on an internal page its first number is the child page.
pages.query: SELECT root, level, fastroot FROM bt_metap('t_pkey');

presets.label: The root page
A leaf page's stats
presets.sql:
SELECT blkno, type, live_items, avg_item_size, free_size, btpo_prev, btpo_next
FROM bt_page_stats('t_pkey', 1);

presets.label: Entries in a leaf
presets.sql:
SELECT itemoffset, ctid, data
FROM bt_page_items('t_pkey', 1) LIMIT 6;

presets.label: Follow the leaf links
presets.sql:
SELECT blkno, btpo_prev, btpo_next, live_items
FROM generate_series(1, 5) AS g, LATERAL bt_page_stats('t_pkey', g);
